# GSVA figures
```{r}
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
here::i_am("quarto/gsva.qmd")

# Attach package
library("GSVA")
library("limma")
library("magrittr")
library("tidyverse")
library("volcano3D")

# Load data
volcano3d_polar <- readRDS(
  file = here::here(
    "output/gsva/volcano3d_polar.RDS"
  )
)

volcano3d_allplots <- readRDS(
  file = here::here(
    "output/gsva/volcano3d_allplots_passages.RDS"
  )
)

```
